about: One entry per model version. Checkpoints are attached to GitHub Releases (tag = release_tag); everything needed to rebuild a version is recorded here. See models/README.md.

rebuild.command: git checkout ce8a1ff && python src/run_train.py && python src/run_test.py
rebuild.notes: Expects datasets/CommonsenseConversation and a CUDA GPU. Contains the x0/epsilon sampling bug (docs/TECHNICAL_NOTES.md), so a rebuilt model reproduces the failure, not a working model. The original checkpoint lived on the HPC scratch space and was not kept.

models.model_summary: 7.5M dialdiff transformer (d256 x 4 layers, 128-d embeddings, seq_len 64)
models.training_summary: first 100k pairs, 2,000 steps x 32 (64k samples), laptop CPU

rebuild.command: git checkout db2613f && python scripts/train.py --preset cpu-small --train-limit 100000 --train-steps 2000 --warmup-steps 200 --eval-every 500 --out runs/cpu-small
rebuild.notes: Seed 0 is fixed, but bit-identical weights also need the same PyTorch build and hardware (CPU, torch 2.15.0+cpu). Expect the same training curve and scores within noise.

checkpoint.contents: config, raw weights ('model'), EMA weights ('ema'), tokenizer name
